import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Filter rows for relevant indicators
relevant_series_names = [
    'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)',
    'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)',
    'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)',
    'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)'
]

# Filter the dataset to include only the relevant series names
df_relevant = df[df['Series Name'].isin(relevant_series_names)]

# Create a new DataFrame with 'Country Code', 'Series Name', 'Year', and 'Value'
df_long = pd.melt(df_relevant, id_vars=['Country Code', 'Series Name'], 
                  value_vars=[col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('19') or col.startswith('20')],
                  var_name='Year', value_name='Value')

# Convert 'Year' to numeric
df_long['Year'] = df_long['Year'].str.extract('(\d+)').astype(int)

# Convert 'Value' to numeric
df_long['Value'] = pd.to_numeric(df_long['Value'], errors='coerce')

# Drop rows with missing values
df_long = df_long.dropna()

# Display the first few rows of the reshaped DataFrame
df_long.head()
